newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus central bank cuts interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus central bank cuts interest rates.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus said it would cut its lending rate to commercial banks to 7.0 percent from 7.5 percent, effective Friday January 17.
The bank would also cut its overnight deposit rate to 4.0 percent from 5.0 percent, effective from the same date, governor Afxentis Afxentiou said.
"These two moves are expected to have a reduction effect on the interest rates of the (retail) market," Afxentiou said.
The governor said the central bank expects commercial banks to cut their retail rates. If they fail to do so they will be advised to do so.
But he could not predict whether retail borrowing or retail deposit rates would be the first to be cut following the central bank move.
The retail borrowing rate is now 8.5 percent and the deposit rate is 7.0 percent.
